bug: stream_coord_rows formatted on workers-1 threads and wrote on the calling thread. Two workers were one formatter plus that writer, so the 2-worker point could not scale.
fix: Every worker formats its own ranges and pwrite()s them. The offset is the header plus the prefix sum of earlier range lengths. A range is written as soon as those lengths are known, so later ranges are still being formatted. Output of the million-atom CON rewrite is 23589082 bytes, sha256 prefix 361546ecf130.

profile_per_worker_s.note: Sums across the ranges that worker formatted, one sample of the direct Rust path on /dev/shm. Wait is the spin for earlier lengths and is ~0.

ceilings.note: Raw 8-thread pwrite of the finished 23.6 MB file, unlink and create each sample. One-thread memcpy is the memory-bandwidth floor for moving those bytes.

direct_rust_unlink_create.note: write_frame_refs_to_path, one warmup, six samples, type-7 median. Same bytes as the campaign write.

campaign_s61.note: 8-thread memory write 0.0074 s is under the 0.0096 s raw tmpfs pwrite. The gap to efficiency 0.8 (0.0065 s) is the part of the format that does not hide behind that write. MPI already pwrites at an exclusive-scan offset; 0.0157 s is that format plus the ~0.011 s page-cache pwrite.
